articles.title: Iran presses for an end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts
articles.summary: Iran's foreign minister called for an end to the war within 30 days, but Trump expressed doubts about the proposal. The US president said he needs to see more from Iran before considering a ceasefire.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill 10 as Zelensky says Ukraine hits oil tankers and terminal
articles.summary: Russian strikes in Ukraine killed 10 people, according to reports. Zelensky said Ukraine's drones hit Russian oil tankers and a terminal, but the extent of the damage is unclear. Fatalities have been reported around Ukraine as Kyiv says Russian "shadow fleet" tankers were hit by drones.

articles.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool
articles.summary: Manchester United hosted Liverpool at Old Trafford, with the match ending in a 2-2 draw. United's Marcus Rashford scored twice, but Liverpool's Mohamed Salah equalized in the second half. Follow the build-up, analysis and live text commentary of the game as United host rivals Liverpool at Old Trafford.

articles.title: Who is Cherie DeVaux, the first female trainer to win the Kentucky Derby?
articles.summary: Cherie DeVaux became the first female trainer to win the Kentucky Derby with her horse Golden Tempo. Jockey Jose Ortiz rode the horse to victory, giving him his first Derby win.

articles.title: ADB launches $70 billion plan for energy, digital infrastructure in Asia-Pacific
articles.summary: The Asian Development Bank launched a $70 billion plan to upgrade energy and digital infrastructure in the Asia-Pacific region. The plan aims to improve connectivity and economic growth in the region.

articles.title: What’s Iran’s 14-point proposal to end the war? And will Trump accept it?
articles.summary: Iran has sent a 14-point proposal to end the war, but mistrust between the two sides is a significant obstacle. Trump is reviewing the proposal, but no decision has been made.

articles.title: Apple says India antitrust body overstepping judicial authority as spat intensifies
articles.summary: Apple disputed India's antitrust body overstepping authority after it sought financial information. The Competition Commission ​of India has since ‌2024 sought Apple’s financial information, typically needed to calculate penalties, after an investigation found it abused its dominant position.

articles.title: Man arrested after allegedly slapping several people at Prinsep Street church
articles.summary: A 33-year-old man was arrested for slapping people at Singapore Life Church. Police say the 33-year-old male suspect is known to Singapore Life Church and had previously caused nuisance there a few times.

articles.title: Foxconn launches second-generation satellites via SpaceX Falcon 9
articles.summary: Foxconn launched second-generation satellites via SpaceX Falcon 9. Foxconn launches second-generation satellites via SpaceX Falcon 9.

articles.title: China issues first prohibition order to safeguard international trade order under rule of law
articles.summary: China issued its first prohibition order to safeguard international trade. China issues first prohibition order to safeguard international trade order under rule of law Global Times.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz blockade and other major naval sieges in modern times
articles.summary: Naval blockades have been used to cut supplies and force surrender in wars. Naval blockades are among the oldest weapons of war, using sea control to cut supplies and force an enemy’s surrender.

articles.title: Hospitals in Lebanon overwhelmed with patients injured by Israeli attacks
articles.summary: Hospitals in Lebanon are overwhelmed with patients injured by Israeli attacks. Hospitals in Lebanon overwhelmed with patients injured by Israeli attacks.

articles.title: Israel approves deal to buy fighter jets from U.S.
articles.summary: Israel approved a deal to buy F-35 and F-15IA fighter jets from the US. The purchase includes a squadron of F-35 multi-role stealth fighters from Lockheed Martin and another of F-15IA warplanes from Boeing, the Defence Ministry said.

articles.title: Two killed and 16 injured in attempted channel crossing from France to U.K.
articles.summary: A makeshift boat carrying 65 people ran aground while attempting to cross the English Channel from France to the UK. Seventeen people were rescued by a French maritime gendarmerie vessel and brought to Boulogne-sur-Mer.

articles.title: Between a fatwa and war: how Iran makes sense of its nuclear capability
articles.summary: Iran has vowed to protect its nuclear stockpile despite Trump's threats. The country's former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei previously disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds. Iran has ‘vowed’ to protect its nuclear stockpile against Trump’s threats even as its former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds.

articles.title: What to Know About Elections in West Bengal and Other Indian States
articles.summary: Vote counting starts in India after 154 million people participated in state elections. Vote counting starts on Monday after over 154 million people participated in elections for state legislatures last month.

articles.title: Taiwan President defiant as he begins Eswatini trip; China calls him a 'rat'
articles.summary: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te began a trip to Eswatini despite China's criticism. Lai Ching-te’s despicable conduct. ​like a rat scurrying across the street. will inevitably be met with ridicule by the international community, says China’s Taiwan ‌Affairs Office spokesperson.

articles.title: Sleepless in Tehran as crowds rally behind the flag
articles.summary: Crowds in Tehran rallied behind the flag with slogans addressing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. A slogan on a wall nearby in Farsi read, “Meydan bashuma, khayabane ba ma”. ‘The battlefield is yours.

articles.title: Diljit Dosanjh Asks Pro-Khalistanis Waving Flag At Canada Concert To Leave
articles.summary: Diljit Dosanjh asked pro-Khalistan supporters to leave his concert in Calgary, Canada, after they waved a flag. Singer Diljit Dosanjh at the concert in Canada's Calgary. Diljit Dosanjh Asks Pro-Khalistanis Waving Flag At Canada Concert To Leave.

articles.title: A Perilous Train Ride Home in Pakistan on the Jaffer Express
articles.summary: The Jaffer Express train in Pakistan faces crossfire in Balochistan. We witnessed crossfire while waiting for the Jaffer Express, a vital lifeline through Balochistan. For many, it’s the only way home.

articles.title: Trump administration approves $8.6 billion arms sales to Middle East amid Iran war deadlock
articles.summary: The US approved $8.6 billion in arms sales to the Middle East. The sales come amid a deadlock in negotiations over Iran's nuclear program and rising tensions in the region.
